data.title: Rent increase request (Mieterhöhungsverlangen) under § 558 BGB
data.summary: Beispielsaar Wohnungsgenossenschaft eG asks Chantal Beispielsaar to consent to raising the net cold rent for her 55 m² apartment from €395.00 to €434.50 (+10%, +€39.50) starting 1 February 2027, based on an expert's local comparison rent of €7.90 per m².
data.explanation: Your housing cooperative has formally asked you to agree to a rent increase under German tenancy law (§ 558 BGB), referring to an expert valuation of comparable local rents. You can either sign and return the enclosed consent declaration, or decline/raise objections. German law gives you a statutory period to decide, which the app will calculate and show you. If you do nothing within that period, the cooperative can sue for your consent, so it's worth reviewing the expert report and, if in doubt, getting advice from a tenants' association before the deadline shown.
